{
  "name": "cloakroom",
  "version": "0.1.5",
  "description": "Check your secrets at the door. Claude gets a ticket; the real value only comes back where you allow it.",
  "homepage": "https://modmyclaude.com/mods/cloakroom",
  "repository": "https://github.com/modmyclaude/claude-code-mods",
  "documentationUrl": "https://github.com/modmyclaude/claude-code-mods/tree/main/mods/cloakroom#readme",
  "supportUrl": "https://github.com/modmyclaude/claude-code-mods/issues",
  "privacyPolicyUrl": "https://modmyclaude.com/privacy",
  "termsOfServiceUrl": "https://modmyclaude.com/terms",
  "author": {
    "name": "modmyclaude"
  },
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "security",
    "secrets",
    "redaction",
    "privacy",
    "api-keys",
    "env"
  ],
  "userConfig": {
    "enabled": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "On",
      "description": "Switch cloakroom off without uninstalling it. The modmyclaude hub flips this too.",
      "default": true
    }
  }
}
